market_context: US stocks are in a broad AI-led selloff. SPY is down about 2% and QQQ about 2.7%, both near their lows of the day. The drivers are the fallout from Jensen Huang's exit as Nvidia CEO, new US curbs on remote access to advanced AI chips, a 10-year yield near 5.12% with a December Fed rate hike priced in, and Nvidia earnings after the close tomorrow. Anthropic's IPO is also due this week. The VIX is up about 22% to 23.5, so the market is oversold and fragile going into the close.

predictions.reasoning: SPY is trading within about 0.2% of its day low of 738.07 after a 2% drop, with 40 minutes left. Oversold conditions and positioning ahead of Nvidia earnings tomorrow often bring a small late bounce. Breadth was weak (about 2.6 decliners per advancer earlier), so I expect only a modest rebound.

QQQ is down 2.7% and sits near its low of 660.53, with the semiconductor index down about 3.7% earlier. Short-term oversold levels and pre-earnings dip buying favor a small bounce into the close. The selling has been persistent, though, so conviction is low.
